name: 单位化按订单生产 - 扩展生产工序 (7VG)
name_en: Unitized Make-to-Order Production – Extended Production Operation (7VG)
description_en_html:
Overview

SAP S/4HANA Manufacturing for production engineering and operations (PEO) is a solution designed to help you manufacture highly engineered and complex products. PEO provides the capabilities you need to model the production process in detail, provide detailed instructions for your production operators, verify that the production process has been executed properly, and record production progress data. It provides the flexibility you require to incorporate engineering changes even if the production process has already started and offers comprehensive change impact analysis. Its modern shop floor user interface integrates everything that operators need to perform their work and quickly deal with any issues they encounter.

The solution process encompasses the production operations and order change for a shop floor order created for demand for a specific unit of product from sales order.

Key Process Flow

  • Plan production in a make-to-order scenario for a specific unit (parameter effectivity) of the product
  • Model the production process in detail to provide detailed instructions for your production operators
  • Assign work to production worker or team
  • Perform operation activities as per shop floor routing configuration
  • Create and manage in-process defect remediated via rework
  • Create and manage in-process defect remediated via Order change
  • Process buyoff workflow as required
  • Review action log, as built and product genealogy for order
  • Complete Order

Business Benefits

  • Increase production efficiency and quality
  • Reduce defect resolution cycle time to improve production engineering efficiency
  • Facilitates agile manufacturing
description_zh_html:
概览

面向生产工程和运营 (PEO) 的 SAP S/4HANA Manufacturing 是一款旨在帮助您制造高度工程化和复杂产品的解决方案。PEO 提供详细建模生产流程所需的功能，为生产操作员提供详细说明，验证生产流程是否已正确执行，并记录生产进度数据。即使生产流程已开始，它还提供合并工程变更所需的灵活性，并提供全面的变更影响分析。其现代化的车间用户界面集成了操作员执行工作所需的一切，并快速处理遇到的任何问题。

解决方案流程包括为销售订单中特定产品单位的需求创建的车间订单的生产工序和订单更改。

关键流程流

  • 为产品的特定单位（参数有效性）计划按订单生产场景中的生产
  • 详细建模生产流程，为生产操作员提供详细说明
  • 将工作分配给生产工人或团队
  • 根据车间工艺路线配置执行工序活动
  • 创建和管理通过返工修复的处理中缺陷
  • 创建和管理通过订单变更修复的处理中缺陷
  • 根据需要处理验收工作流
  • 检查订单的构建和产品谱系操作日志
  • 完成订单

业务优势

  • 提高生产效率和质量
  • 缩短缺陷解决周期，提高生产工程设计效率
  • 促进敏捷制造
